gemini-advisor.note: Registered architecturally. Reports unavailable until ~/.config/mythos-ai-executor/gemini.env provides MYTHOS_GEMINI_API_KEY — a Gemini Plus subscription is NOT an API credential and none is invented.

free-llm-pool.note: Meta-agent over free-llm/catalog.json — selects and auto-falls-back across free-tier LLM services discovered from raullenchai/free-llm-api-resources. Reports unavailable until an operator creates a credential file under ~/.config/mythos-ai-executor/free-llm/<provider>.env for at least one wired provider (see free-llm/README.md) — none is invented, and no key from the upstream list is ever used.

haddad-qwen.note: MYTHOS HADDAD V2.1: the local Qwen worker (providers/haddad-agent.js — tools in a per-command bwrap sandbox, mechanical validation, bounded repair). Availability is PROBED: the provider's enable marker + runtime key must exist AND the local llama-server must answer /health, so on the VPS — no marker, no runtime — it is unavailable and can never be selected. review_scope is deliberately ["standard"] only: core/validation.js refuses it as the reviewer of any sensitive (commit-producing) change. cost tier "local" ranks with "free" in the registry's ordering.
